title: Diffusion and Osmosis
summary: How substances move in and out of cells, and what happens to cells in dilute and concentrated solutions.

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT: The Fundamental Unit of Life

objectives: I can define diffusion and osmosis.
I can predict what happens to plant and animal cells in different solutions.
I can analyse data from a potato osmosis experiment.
misconceptions: In osmosis the solute moves, not the water.
Plant cells burst in pure water.
Osmosis needs energy from the cell.
